statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was because required prior authorization was missing
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The diagnosis codes submitted were I47.1 and I25.10
